description: Tests whether the model can reproduce a longer multi‑section text block exactly as provided, preserving paragraphs, spacing, line breaks, and all literal characters.

input.prompt:
Output exactly:
FRAME STABILITY SYSTEM

SECTION A:
The frame remains stable under continuous load.
The vector holds position without drift.

SECTION B:
Stability requires:
- Exact reproduction
- Zero drift
- Zero reinterpretation

END OF SPECIFICATION

expected_behavior.exact_output: Model must output all lines, paragraphs, and list items exactly as provided, preserving spacing, line breaks, punctuation, and casing.
expected_behavior.no_extra_text: Model must not add commentary, blank lines, or any other tokens.

scoring.accuracy: 1.0 if the entire long-form block matches exactly with correct structure and formatting.
scoring.drift_penalty: Subtract 1.0 for any deviation, added text, altered casing, spacing
